brief:
Israeli authorities have stepped up security preparations ahead of planned pro-Gaza demonstrations expected across the West Bank and other areas, the Ma'an news agency reported. Officials have deployed additional personnel and implemented heightened checkpoint protocols in anticipation of the rallies. The move reflects concern over the scale of expected turnout among Palestinians seeking to voice solidarity with Gaza.

Organizers have called for widespread participation in the demonstrations, with activists planning coordinated actions across multiple locations. The planned rallies signal sustained grassroots momentum in support of Gaza amid ongoing regional tensions and the humanitarian situation in the enclave.
title: Gaza supporters plan demonstrations across territories
